The fault is in M2's multiplier. The netlist has `m=3`, which makes the effective mirror ratio about 2.86 (19.28 × 3 / 20.23) instead of 1. The operating points confirm it: M2 carries 59.7 µA against a 20 µA target, which matches the 198.6% error. The rout drop is consistent with the same cause, since M2 carries about 3× the current and its gds rises. The sensitivities agree: increasing M2 worsens the error, and increasing M1 reduces the ratio and improves it.

Only two devices exist in this netlist, so M1 is the only other candidate. Its operating point is consistent with a healthy 20 µA reference, so it is unlikely to be the corrupted element.
